name: CMC excipient review
description: For each CMC section: excipient grade, justification, guidance cited, and conflicts with the current spec.

columns.label: Excipient grade(s)
columns.question: Which excipient grades are specified? List each as 'excipient: grade'.

columns.label: Justification
columns.question: What justification is given for the choice of excipient grade(s)?

columns.label: Guidance cited
columns.question: Which regulatory guidances, guidelines or pharmacopoeial chapters are cited?

columns.label: Contradicts current spec?
columns.question: Does this section indicate that an excipient grade differs from, or has replaced, the current specification?

name: Health authority commitments
description: For each HA letter: commitments made, due date, whether met, and owner.

columns.label: Commitments
columns.question: What commitments did the company (sponsor/applicant/MAH) make? List each separately.

columns.label: Due date
columns.question: What is the due date of the commitment(s)? If several, give the earliest.

columns.label: Met?
columns.question: Does this letter state whether the commitment has been fulfilled?

columns.label: Owner
columns.question: Who is named as responsible for the commitment (name and role)?

name: Stability protocol review
description: The same 6 questions of each stability protocol.

columns.label: Storage conditions
columns.question: What storage conditions are tested (long-term, intermediate, accelerated, in-use)?

columns.label: Acceptance criteria
columns.question: What are the acceptance criteria? List each as 'test: criterion'.

columns.label: Deviations
columns.question: What does the protocol say about deviations or storage excursions?

columns.label: Bracketing justification
columns.question: Is bracketing or matrixing used, and what is the justification?

columns.label: Post-approval commitment
columns.question: What post-approval stability commitment is stated?
